{{Quote|You don't kill as many stormtroopers as I have by playing it safe.|Biv Bodhrik|<ref name="Twin Shadows" />}}
'''Biv Bodhrik''' was a guerrilla fighter allied with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the events of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He alongside [[Saska Teft/Legends|Saska Teft]] were dispatched to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to both investigate a growing Imperial presence on the planet and to find the freelance member [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who had disappeared during his assignment in investigating the planet at [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], as they were considered among the Rebel Alliance's best operatives.

==Biography==
[[File:Stay_Down_IA-TS.png|thumb|left|250px|Bodhrik facing a squad of stormtroopers]]
{{Quote|Holding ground isn't nearly as important as gaining it.|Biv Bodhrik|<ref name="Twin Shadows" />}}
Biv Bodhrik joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] as a guerrilla fighter and eventually rose in the ranks, being driven by a thirst for vengeance for something that happened in his past relating to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He eventually was sent to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to find [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and investigate rumors of a growing Imperial presence on the planet, working together with the engineer Saska Teft.

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I will make you pay!|Biv Bodhrik|<ref name="Twin Shadows" />}}
Biv Bodhrik held extreme desires for vengeance. He was proficient in various weaponry, although his preferred weapon was heavy weaponry. He also could affix his weapons with a [[Vibrobayonet/Legends|vibrobayonet]], and was skilled enough in guerrilla warfare to overwhelm even the greatest servants of the Empire.<ref name="Fight for Freedom" />

==Behind the scenes==
Biv Bodhrik is one of two hero characters in the ''[[Twin Shadows]]'' expansion pack for the tactical land-based RPG game ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Assault]]'' by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].
